entities.name: PMID:25092916
observations: 2014 Molecular Cancer Research primary study titled “Phosphoproteomic profiling reveals IL6-mediated paracrine signaling within the Ewing sarcoma family of tumors.”

EWS/FLI1 knockdown, mass-spectrometry phosphoproteomics, single-cell analysis, conditioned-medium transfer, cytokine analysis, and ligand/receptor inhibition supported tumor-cell-to-tumor-cell IL-6-associated STAT3 signaling.
The study did not directly establish tumor–microenvironment signaling or every canonical IL-6R/JAK/STAT3 component.

entities.name: PMID:38906855
observations: 2024 Ewing sarcoma study of JAK1/STAT6/GAS6/TAM signaling; available indexed evidence does not demonstrate IL-6-mediated paracrine signaling or a phosphoproteomic IL-6 ligand/receptor circuit.

entities.name: IL6 paracrine ESFT
observations: In ESFT cell models, EWS/FLI1-deficient cells generated a soluble signal that activated STAT3 phosphorylation in neighboring ESFT cells retaining EWS/FLI1.
Conditioned-medium transfer and cytokine/inhibition experiments implicated IL-6; apoptosis protection was a functional consequence.
Evidence supports tumor-cell-to-tumor-cell IL-6-associated paracrine signaling, but not necessarily a complete IL-6R/JAK1/2/STAT3 cascade.
